_source: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), fetched 2026-09-26. Pins: points on named streets (Overpass) inside curated localities whose centres are OSM place nodes; every pin reverse-geocoded with Nominatim and its locality/street taken from OSM where they differed; pins OSM places outside Dhaka city or inside a cantonment dropped. Coverage: every street node in the city fabric is within ~1.15 km of a salon (99.96% within 1 km). probes: 300 random street nodes for the post-seed 1 km check.
